title: Chapter 330: Head-On Confrontation With All Possible Means
content:
Chapter 330: Head-On Confrontation With All Possible Means

Northern War Zone.

The elusive Zerg and Protoss joint army could always accurately find the location of the main force of the Snow Demon Clan and launch a surprise attack on it.

Every battle ended with the main force of the Snow Demon Clan being annihilated by the Zerg and Protoss joint army.

The Snow Demon Clan, which had suffered a lot of losses, finally asked for a powerful artifact of the faith in the gods to crack the invisibility blessing of the Protoss arbitrator.

The power of the evil god in this world is one level higher than the ten-star great power level. In Wu Qing's original cultivation system, it is the eleventh level emperor level.

The eleventh level of strength is a powerful existence that can initially contact the power of the world rules even in a world where the world rules are completely normal.

In this world where the rules are incomplete, the power of the evil god has been terribly strengthened.

An artifact of the evil god is enough to crack the invisibility blessing provided by the Protoss arbitrator at the level of the rules of this world.

The Snow Demon Clan, with an artifact as the core, has assembled a large number of elite troops of the Snow Demon Clan, and many Snow Demon Clan strongmen have also arrived one after another.

The Snow Demon Clan has long occupied the Northern War Zone, a unique environment for them, and has cultivated a large number of Snow Demon warriors. In terms of the number of warriors, few races in the world can compare with them.

The Snow Demon Clan has so much confidence that it is calm against the Zerg. Even if it is at a disadvantage in the battle of the main force, they think it is very normal.

The Snow Demon Clan always believes that the elite troops of the Zerg are limited. This can be seen from the fact that the Protoss troops only appear in the Northern War Zone, which shows that the Zerg has placed the most powerful troops in the Northern War Zone.

In the eyes of outsiders, the main force of the Zerg is still the Zerg puppies. The Zerg puppies that can be seen everywhere are the most impressive.

Wu Qing really has no way to hatch and materialize high-star Zerg and Protoss arms without limit, but as long as the Zerg and Protoss have wars to fight, the Zerg and Protoss are famous, and the number of the Zerg and Protoss joint army will continue to grow rapidly.

To be honest, I have been using the Huanyuan app to read books and keep up with the latest updates. It can switch sources and has many voices for reading. Huanyuanapp is available for both Android and Apple.

In order to deal with the powerful snow beast tide offensive of the Snow Demon Clan, the Zerg Puppies and Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions in the Northern War Zone have powerful Zerg and Protoss troops to assist in combat.

Zerg Scorpions, Zerg Queens, Zerg Mammoths, Protoss Dragon Knights, Protoss Gold Beetles and other powerful troops of the two tribes, together with the Zerg Puppies and Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions spread all over the snowfield, resist the ice beast tide.

The plague of the Zerg Scorpions, the parasitic control of the Zerg Queens, and the invincible defense and attack capabilities of the Zerg Mammoths are very effective against the snow beast tides of varying strengths.

The seven-star Protoss Dragon Knights and seven-star Protoss Gold Beetles, which are not suitable for participating in the joint army of the Zerg and Protoss, are placed on the front line to resist the snow beast tide. It is the best choice, which can greatly reduce the defense pressure of the Zerg Puppies and Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions.

With the support of so many powerful arms, the situation in the area where the Zerg and Protoss joint base is located has finally stabilized.

As the proportion of powerful Zerg and Protoss arms continues to increase, the number of Zerg puppies and Type III Zerg poisonous ray scorpions continues to increase, and the Zerg and Protoss armies will soon completely resist the terrible snow beast tide and expand the scope of the actual control area.

…

The Snow Demon Clan continues to send out its main force as bait to lure the Zerg and Protoss joint army to raid and annihilate everywhere. In the rear, a terrible Snow Demon Clan army slowly gathered.

The intelligence detection capabilities of the Zerg and Protoss are very powerful. Wu Qing has actually discovered signs that the Snow Demon Clan is gathering a large army, but he deliberately pretended not to know.

It is much more refreshing to concentrate forces to fight a few big battles than to play hide-and-seek like looking for enemies everywhere.

The Snow Demon Clan is gathering superior forces, and Wu Qing is also preparing for a big war.

Facing the powerful Snow Demon army, Zerg troops below five stars have no need to participate in the battle. They are easily harmed by the large amount of ice battlefield magic of the Snow Demon, causing heavy casualties.

The main combat troops of the Zerg are only the five-star Zerg Devourer and the five-star Zerg Sky Guard, which can only play supporting roles.

A large number of five-star Zerg Devourers were hatched in the joint base of the Zerg and Protoss. The huge bodies of nearly ten meters soared into the air, entered the passage, and flew to the snowfield where the battle never stopped.

The Zerg scorpions and Zerg queens, which were originally regarded as high-end auxiliary troops and existed in small quantities, are now hatched on a large scale. The plague of the Zerg scorpions and the black bees, and the parasitic control of the Zerg queens are all magical skills to assist in killing enemies on the battlefield.

Wu Qing invested more resources in the embodiment of the Protoss troops.

The minimum strength of the Protoss troops is seven stars, which has a strength advantage. Even if the resource consumption is very large, they are also large in size and have high combat efficiency, so they are not at a disadvantage.

A large number of seven-star Protoss reconnaissance aircraft, seven-star Protoss pirate ships and seven-star Protoss motherships are the main combat forces of the Protoss. With the powerful Protoss Arbiter spacecraft, the main combat forces of the Protoss are complete.

Protoss Berserkers, Protoss High Templars, Protoss Dark Templars, Protoss Light Archons and Protoss Dark Archons, these Protoss warriors basically work in the Protoss Arbitration Court.

If they are needed to participate in the battle on the battlefield, they can be instantly teleported to the battlefield through the Arbiter spacecraft controlled by the Light Archon, so they do not need to follow the participating troops at any time.

The days passed as both sides continued to prepare for war.

When the Snow Demon Clan finally assembled an unprecedentedly powerful army, a super-large-scale war kicked off on the boundless snowfield.

Sensing the movements of the Snow Demon Clan army, the Zerg and Protoss joint army no longer attacked everywhere, but retreated to the vicinity of the joint base to rest.

At this time, the scale of the Zerg and Protoss joint army was already very large. The five-star Zerg Devourer, the main force of the battle, had reached tens of millions of troops.

The huge Protoss combat spacecraft of various types were densely packed, covering the sky and the sun. At first glance, it was thought that they had arrived at an interstellar battlefield.

In order to eliminate the Zerg, the wealthy Snow Demon Clan had already included the area where the Zerg and Protoss joint base was located into the lord's protection range, which enabled them to attack the Zerg army day and night without giving the Zerg army time to rest.

The battlefield of the Snow Demon Tribe's scheduled battle is also in this area, and their army is coming in a mighty manner.

Wu Qing did not send troops to stop them, but only sent the Zerg host and the Protoss unmanned probe spacecraft to monitor the situation of the Snow Demon Tribe's army.

Wu Qing has guessed through the reaction of the Snow Demon Tribe's army that the Snow Demon Tribe has found a way to crack the rule-level stealth ability of the Zerg and Protoss.

The world rules of this world are so chaotic, it is not surprising that the Snow Demon Tribe can solve the problem of the Zerg and Protoss army's stealth in such a short time.

Since it is known that the Snow Demon Tribe can see the Zerg and Protoss joint army, the various defensive means of the Zerg and Protoss can be used. The large-scale ice magic of the Snow Demon Tribe's army is very lethal, and the five-star Zerg troops will also suffer certain damage.

The black bees of the Zerg scorpion continue to cover the Zerg and Protoss joint army, forming a huge insect field to protect the Zerg and Protoss joint army.

In the snowy environment, the marching speed of the Snow Demon Clan army was very fast. It didn't take much time for the Snow Demon Clan's super army to rush to the vicinity of the Zerg and Protoss joint army.

The snowy beast tide did not stop because of the arrival of the Snow Demon Clan's super army. Various snowy creatures just gave the Snow Demon Clan's super army a huge battlefield.

When the Snow Demon Clan's super army used the artifact to break the invisibility of the Zerg and Protoss joint army, they saw the black fog all over the sky, but still couldn't see the real body of the Zerg and Protoss joint army!

"This is just a defensive method of the Zerg, just attack the black fog area!"

The Snow Demon Clan now has a certain understanding of the Zerg, and has obtained a lot of intelligence from other tribes. They are also familiar with the black bees of the Zerg scorpions.

The Snow Demon Clan army is aware of the powerful firepower of the Zerg and Protoss joint army. They began to release powerful battlefield-level ice magic at a very long distance. Even if they can't attack the enemy, they can change the environment of the snowy field to a certain extent, making the battlefield environment more suitable for the Snow Demon Clan army to fight.

In the combined forces of the Zerg and Protoss, some five-star Zerg air guards with super long range launched an attack on the distant Snow Demon army in the black fog.

They did not seek to kill many enemies, but only to gain the upper hand.

"Boom...!"

The explosion sounded in the Snow Demon army, and the Snow Demon army began to suffer casualties.

The countless powerful Snow Demons in the Snow Demon army controlled the ice energy, integrated with the surrounding environment, and slowly produced a certain energy resonance.

The terrible ice energy became violent, and a super-large-scale terrible blizzard appeared out of thin air on the battlefield.

The world was filled with terrifying ice energy, making it impossible for all normal life to survive.

The snow creatures in the surrounding area stopped attacking and entered a self-protection state. Even so, a large number of creatures that originally lived on the snow died.

The Zerg puppies and Type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions that were close all drilled under the thick ice layer.

The Zerg and Protoss joint army, which was attacked head-on, was protected by the black fog formed by the Zerg Scorpion Black Bee. In addition, their minimum strength was five stars, so they could still hold on under the natural disaster-level attack of the Snow Demon Army.

The seven-star Protoss combat spacecraft of various types were of course not a problem. This kind of extreme cold energy attack would at most consume some energy for them, and they could recover instantly through the energy network.

The Snow Demon Army continued to advance and entered the attack range of the main combat arms of the Zerg and Protoss joint army. The main attack arms, mainly the five-star Zerg Devourer, launched a fierce attack.

The mucus attack of the Zerg Devourer instantly turned the snow-white snowfield into a sea of terrible corrosive mucus!

As long as the soldiers of the Snow Demon Army were stuck with this mucus, they would immediately suffer very terrible corrosive damage, even the Snow Demon in the energy state was no exception.

Even if they don't encounter this corrosive mucus, the special spores constantly released in the mucus will infect the surrounding enemies, slowing down their attack speed, weakening their attack ability, weakening their defense ability, and even weakening their vitality.

As long as the Snow Demon army is in the attack range of the five-star Zerg Devourer and the surrounding area, it is basically useless.

The seven-star Protoss combat spacecraft of various types use large-scale destructive technology weapons to fight, and the attack effect is another extreme. The powerful explosion attack and various beam and radiation attacks are simply the nemesis of the Snow Demon army.

A full-scale attack by the Zerg and Protoss combined forces caused a part of the Snow Demon Clan to disappear forever.

…

The Snow Demon Clan was not to be outdone. They released a large amount of offensive ice magic, which fell on the black fog of the Zerg and Protoss combined forces, and continuously consumed the microscopic insects that made up the black fog.

Each Snow Demon is a master of ice magic. So many ice magic masters gathered together in this icy and snowy environment, and the combat power they exerted was very terrifying.

Even with the defense of the black fog, many five-star Zerg Devourers also suffered some damage.

The natural disaster-level ice magic has been continuing, and now with the addition of targeted ice attack magic, the Zerg Scorpion's black bees can't hold on a bit.

Some Zerg Scorpions began to move, using the elimination skill to attack the Snow Demon Clan army, quickly recovering energy and skill status, and constantly replenishing the consumed black fog.

Some Zerg scorpions used the plague skill to create plague areas in the Snow Demon army. Active attack is the best defense.

With the help of the plague area, the efficiency of the Zerg and Protoss joint army in killing enemies has been further increased.

The Zerg Queen's parasitic control began to attack those non-Snow Demon races in the Snow Demon army, controlling a large number of non-Snow Demon soldiers to create chaos.

The Zerg and Protoss joint army used various means to eliminate the living forces of the Snow Demon army as quickly as possible.

The Snow Demon army took advantage of the strength of troops and environment, and continuously attacked the Zerg and Protoss joint army through powerful ice magic.

The Snow Demon army even used many divine-level powers to try to break the defense line of the Zerg and Protoss joint army in one fell swoop, but ultimately failed.

The Snow Demon Clan brought out various battlefield treasures, artifacts bestowed by gods, magical objects seized from other clans, and other clan heritage, which really opened Wu Qing's eyes. These items containing the power of world rules have certain effects on the battlefield, but the effect is limited.

Especially for the Zerg and Protoss joint army guarded by the Queen of the Zerg, the general world rule-level power can't make any waves.

After both sides exhausted their tricks, they finally returned to the competition of basic strength.

The most powerful killing effect of the Zerg and Protoss joint army is still the tens of millions of five-star Zerg Devourers. Their attack is a sea of mucus falling on the snowfield, and the killing effect can be imagined.

The most powerful attack effect of the Snow Demon Clan army is the natural disaster-level ice magic, which restrains a large number of Zerg scorpions to supplement the black bees, and also causes many five-star Zerg Devourers to be injured.
